description.value: Driftwood Great Chinese Buffet is the Nanaimo outpost of a Vancouver Island–owned chain celebrated for its all-you-can-eat lunch and dinner buffets alongside a full à la carte Chinese menu. The chain prides itself on fresh, hand-crafted dishes made with 100% vegetable oil and no added MSG, and each location features a full bar with local beers. Cycling through Nanaimo's south end, riders will find both dine-in and take-out options readily available.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 62m; rack at 94m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Nanaimo location of the Driftwood Restaurants chain at 4711 Rutherford Rd with phone (250) 585-5386, matching OSM tags exactly. The front page explicitly states 'Eat-In, Take-Out Welcome,' confirming takeout. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Nanaimo location is confirmed open and operational per the website, with address and phone matching OSM. A real, publicly accessible restaurant useful to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menus consistently list 'Spring Roll(veg)' and vegetable-based dishes; all menus note '100% Vegetable Oil & No Added MSG.'

price.label: Casual
price.signal: Explicitly 'affordable prices'; all-you-can-eat buffet sit-down format
